info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Legal Entities Management API
info.description: The Legal Entities Management API facilitates the updating of legal entity information within a banking context. This endpoint is designed for businesses looking to maintain accurate records of their legal entities, allowing users to modify details such as names, addresses, and identification numbers. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions, compliance teams, and financial services providers who require up-to-date legal entity data for regulatory compliance and operational efficiency. By ensuring that legal entity information is current, organizations can enhance their risk management and decision-making processes.

put.summary: Update a legal entity by its ID.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific legal entity identified by its ID. You will need to provide the required fields in the request body to make the necessary changes to the legal entity's information.
